paragraphs.text:
PIOSOTOS CAFE
As you enter the cafe, the thick, acrid tobacco smoke chokes 
you. The place is filled with laughing, gesticulating dockworkers 
and sailors. If you’re here, expecting to meet someone, go to 35.
Looking around, you can approach any of the following if 
you have Christos with you, or if you can make a successful 
Language (Greek) roll for each one you try: for the group in 
back playing cards, go to 107; for the burly sailors at the bar, go 
to 105. For the Englishman alone at a table, you need make no 
roll to approach him; go to 35. 
(Athens Location)
